info.name: Azure Repos Git Commits Repositories API

params.name: includeLinks
params.description: Include reference links in the response

params.name: includeAllUrls
params.description: Set to true to include all remote URLs in the response. Defaults to false.

params.name: includeHidden
params.description: Set to true to include hidden repositories. Defaults to false.

items.docs: Retrieve all Git repositories in the specified project. Each repository includes its ID, name, default branch, remote URL, SSH URL, and web URL. Optionally include reference links and hidden repositories.
Create a new Git repository in the specified project. Provide the repository name and optionally a parent repository for forking.

params.name: repositoryId
params.description: The ID or name of the repository

items.docs: Retrieve a specific Git repository by its ID or name. Returns full repository details including default branch, clone URLs, project reference, and size.

params.name: repositoryId
params.description: The ID or name of the repository

items.docs: Update a Git repository with a new name or a new default branch. Only the fields provided in the request body are updated.

params.name: repositoryId
params.description: The ID or name of the repository

items.docs: Delete a Git repository from the project. This operation is irreversible and removes all branches, commits, and pull requests associated with the repository.
